name: select
sql: SELECT i.quantity, i.amount, i.active, i.label FROM Item i ORDER BY i.quantity LIMIT 10

name: filter
sql: SELECT i.quantity, i.amount FROM Item i WHERE i.active = TRUE ORDER BY i.quantity LIMIT 10

name: group-count
sql: SELECT i.active, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Item i GROUP BY i.active ORDER BY i.active LIMIT 10

name: join
sql: SELECT i.quantity AS left_quantity, j.quantity AS right_quantity FROM Item i INNER JOIN Item j ON i.quantity = j.quantity ORDER BY i.quantity LIMIT 10

name: count
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Item i
